focused.visualCheck: Custom-font text and line layout closely agree with PDFium; small pixel differences remain.

behavior: Before mappings begin, recovery can discard CMapName definitions containing unescaped spaces and simple ASCII fragments after the initial name. A same-line def must occur within 4096 bytes. Delimiters, line breaks, mapping operators, and missing terminators prevent the repair. Strict parsing and character mappings are unchanged.
limitations: Single-file timing is not a throughput benchmark. Full PDF.js coverage has not been rerun; the prior selected54 recheck predates this fix.
